name: @zouxuyang/frontend-api-evidence-gate
description: Framework-agnostic AI frontend acceptance runner with browser and API evidence.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test --test-name-pattern='^(layout rules|visual review cannot|spec schemas)' tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --test --test-name-pattern='^browser layout metrics' tests/*.test.mjs
